---
name: Skill request
about: Request a new skill or propose an upstream skill import
title: "[skill request] "
labels: ["skill-request"]
---

## What skill do you want?

Name the skill and describe what it should cover.

## Category

Which category does it belong in (core, frontend, backend, database, auth,
architecture, infrastructure, testing, security, SEO, performance, content,
media, metadata, documentation)? Or is it an upstream import?

## Why is it needed?

What task would this skill help agents do, and what happens without it?

## Official sources

Link the official documentation or source repository this skill would be
based on. For an upstream import, include the source repository URL and its
license.

## Upstream import checklist (only for imports)

- [ ] The source license permits redistribution (MIT, Apache-2.0, or
      equivalent).
- [ ] The skill name does not collide with an existing skill in this
      repository.
- [ ] The skill fits this library's scope (software engineering, SEO,
      content, media).

## Additional context

Anything else that helps evaluate the request.
